payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort arrival times, then process three sequential stages. For each stage, iterate in sorted order and greedily assign to the next available window by ensuring start time is at least the finish time of the k-th earlier person.
payload.rationale: Despite importing heapq, the solution never uses it. It relies entirely on sorting arrivals and a greedy window assignment using a simple array, characteristic of greedy_sorting_order.
